_comment: CVE Database - Local knowledge base of known vulnerabilities. Format: product -> [ {affected_versions, cve, severity (CVSS v3 0-10), desc, vector?} ]

nginx.desc: HTTP/2 DoS via memory exhaustion (MEMORYCORRUPTION in nghttp2)
HTTP request smuggling via transfer-encoding header
Integer overflow in range filter leads to information disclosure

apache.desc: Truncation of files with AllowOverride All (files with <NEWLINE> bypass upload)
Weak Digest Auth nonce generation allows replay attacks

redis.desc: Authenticated RCE via Lua CJSON library (heap overflow)
Integer overflow in ziplist -> heap overflow RCE
MSETNX with huge key count leads to DoS via assertion crash

vsftpd.desc: Deliberate backdoor in vsftpd-2.3.4.tar.gz - open shell on port 6200 :)
Remote DoS via certain ftp commands (memory leak)

postfix.desc: OpenSSL key recovery attack (DROWN-like) when exporting keys

exim.desc: Local/Remote command injection in Exim transport (The Return of the WIZard)
Remote unauthenticated RCE chain (21Nails - heap-based overflow in spool)

openssh.desc: Roaming feature information leak - private key bits leak
RCE in scp - server side controls client-side execution (SCP protocol issue)

mysql.desc: Critical MySQL Remote Root Code Execution / Privesc (malloc-based glibc poisoning)
Privilege Escalation / Race condition to root (exploit chain via MySQL root)

postgresql.desc: Password hash login bypass with empty password - empty password accepted
pg_dump RCE via SELECT with libpq RowDescription overflow

mongodb.desc: Default NoAuth bind 0.0.0.0 in MongoDB - remote unauthenticated full DB access
SSRF via JavaScript scope in MapReduce

mssql.desc: SQL Server 2000 Resolution Service buffer overflow (SQL Slammer worm)
SQL Server 2005 Remote Code Execution via Extended Stored Procedures (heap overflow)

telnet.desc: Telnet transmits credentials in cleartext - use SSH instead

bind.desc: TKEY query DoS crash - assert failure in resolver

drupal.desc: Drupalgeddon2 - unauthenticated remote code execution via Form API
Arbitrary PHP code execution via crafted file upload
SA-CORE-2023-005 access bypass (unsafe link submit callback)

apache.desc: Path traversal to RCE via misconfigured mod_cgi (2.4.49)
Newline injection in .htaccess allowing file upload RCE under CGI
Root privilege escalation via mod_prefork/apache2ctl race

php.desc: PHP-FPM env_path_info parsing RCE (PHPMailer-style query string)
php-cgi query string RCE - arbitrary code execution as web user
PHP2Shell - unauth RCE via memory_limit exhaustion / OOM corruption in the PHP core Zend engine (exploited in the wild since 2026-10-17). Fixed in 8.5.12 / 8.4.27 / 8.3.36 / 8.2.35.
PHP2Shell - unauth RCE via stale request state reuse after a failed OOM allocation (companion vector to CVE-2026-109618). Fixed in 8.5.12 / 8.4.27 / 8.3.36 / 8.2.35.

wordpress.desc: Media library XXE via WAVE file upload (server-side request disclosure)
Remote code execution via post meta edit & theme editor path traversal
CSRF in post-by-email so users can be forced to expose unpublished posts
